units: <cite ref="Yoma 69b:15">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite> <he>זו היא גְּבוּרָתוֹ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>גְּבוּרַת גבורתו</he>) in this His strength consists (in His long-suffering).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:9">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>י׳ קבים ג׳ וכ׳</he> ten measures of bravery have come down into the world, nine of which the Persians have taken; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Esth. R. to I, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (allud. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 10:17">Koh. X, 17</cite> a.
<cite ref="Isaiah 5:22">Is. V, 22</cite>) <he>ג׳ של תורה וכ׳</he> the strength (acquired by the study) of the Law consists in ‘happy’, the strength of wine in ‘woe’; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 88b">Ib. 88ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מפי הג׳</he> from the mouth of the Lord.

senses.gloss: manifestations of Divine power, wonders. Yoma l. c. איה גְּבוּרוֹתָיו where are the evidences of His power (that we should call Him גבור)?—

G’buroth, the second section of the T’fillah (v. אָבוֹת), praising the powers of the Lord, also called תְּחִיַית הַמֵּתִים. Y. Ber. IV, end, 8ᶜ this is the order &c. אבות וג׳ וכ׳ Aboth, G’buroth, and Kiddush hash-Shem (K’dushah).—ג׳ גְּשָׁמִים the power of rain, a clause praising the Lord for giving rains, inserted in G’buroth.
units: Ber. V, 2 מזכירין ג׳ גש׳ we mention ‘the power of rain’, i.e. insert the clause, in ‘the Resurrection’, contrad. to the prayer for rain (שַׁאֲלָה).
Taan. 2ᵃ מאי ג׳ גש׳ וכ׳ why is it named G’buroth G’shamim? Ans. מפני שיורדין בגבורה because the rains come down through (God’s) wonderful power (ref. to Job. V, 9—10).—

senses.gloss: (allusion to Ps. XC, 10) the age of eighty.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:10">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>שמונים ג׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="C00062"><he>גבורה</he></cite>) ‘eighty years’ is called g’buroth (g’burah).

<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 3:8">Treat. S’maḥoth III, 8</cite> <he>מיתה של גבורה</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1:3">Y. Bicc. II, 64ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>של זקנה</he>) a death of g’burah (at a high age); <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:21">Ab. V, 21</cite> <he>בן שמנים לגבורה</he>. M. Kat. l. c. <he>הגיע לג׳</he> if one has reached the age of eighty.
